{{Quote|The Crook, the Wook and Me. Volume two of my memoirs.''"<br />"''Who's a crook?|Leia Organa Solo telling Han Solo the title of her memoir|<ref name="Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>}}
'''''The Crook, the Wook, and Me''''' was the title of the second volume of [[Leia Organa Solo's memoir]]. In [[43 ABY]], Leia decided the name of her memoir's second volume after she was inspired by her retelling of how [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] [[Cloud City Sabacc Tournament|won]] the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] from [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] to her granddaughter [[Allana Djo Solo]]. Leia planned for chapter seven of her memoir's second volume to cover Han and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] [[mission to Dellalt]] where they uncovered the [[Treasure Vaults of Xim the Despot|treasure vault]] of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]].<ref name="Falcon" />
